title: Integrability of a double Gaussian phase
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $a,b\in\mathbb R$, let $x\in\mathbb R^n$, and let $f:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$ be integrable under the product standard Gaussian measure $\gamma^n$. For $u,w\in\mathbb R^n$, set $\Phi_t(u,w)=\exp\bigl(i t\sum_{j=1}^n u_jw_j\bigr)$. Then $(u,w)\mapsto\Phi_a(u,x)\Phi_b(w,u)f(w)$ is integrable, as a complex-valued function, under $\gamma^n\times\gamma^n$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is integrable under the product standard Gaussian measure
